seoDescription: Compact digital kitchen scale that weighs up to 500 g in 0.1 g steps. Ideal for coffee, baking and small ingredients. Several colours. Shop Drapewell.
descriptionHtml:
Precision Digital Kitchen Scale for Coffee, Baking & Everyday Measuring

Measure small ingredients accurately with this compact digital kitchen scale, designed for coffee dosing, baking, spices, tea, pet food, jewellery and other precise portions. Its 0.1 g readability and 500 g maximum capacity make it a practical addition to any kitchen or coffee setup.

Why You’ll Love It

  • 0.1 g precision: Helps you measure fine ingredients and coffee doses with confidence.
  • 500 g capacity: Suitable for small baking portions, espresso and pour-over coffee, spices and everyday kitchen use.
  • Four measurement units: Switch between grams (g), ounces (oz), carats (ct) and grains (gn).
  • Compact and portable: Slim ABS design stores easily in a drawer, cabinet or travel coffee kit.
  • Eight colour options: Choose White, Black, Yellow, Pink, Blue, Dark Green, Light Blue or Purple Red.

Specifications

  • Capacity: 500 g
  • Precision: 0.1 g
  • Units: g, oz, ct, gn
  • Material: ABS plastic
  • Dimensions: 230 × 55 × 24 mm
  • Product weight: 80 g
  • Power: 1 × CR2032 battery required (not included)

In the Box

1 × Digital kitchen scale

For best results, place the scale on a stable, level surface before use.
